name: Demand
definition: Document signed by the beneficiary demanding payment under a demand guarantee or standby letter of credit.

SubmissionDateTime.name: Submission Date Time
SubmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time the demand is submitted.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of demand, for example, pay or extend.

TotalClaimAmount.name: Total Claim Amount
TotalClaimAmount.definition: Amount and currency of the total amount claimed (sum of the demand amount plus counterparty commission and charges).

Undertaking.name: Undertaking
Undertaking.definition: Undertaking for which a document signed by the beneficiary demanding payment is specified.

AssociatedDocument.name: Associated Document
AssociatedDocument.definition: Documents which are associated with a demand.
